summary: 64-year-old female from Bismarck, ND, overdue attempting to ski to Margy's Hut (10th Mountain hut, ~8 mi NE of Aspen); voluntarily separated from her group around noon near Johnson Creek. MRA deployed by snowmobile from the C.B. Cameron Rescue Center; made contact ~11:07pm; overdue skier found safely at the hut in good health.
location: Margy's Hut / Johnson Creek, ~8 mi NE of Aspen
